item.tib: tshe dbang drag 'khros kyi rgyud las ltas ngan brgyud cu bzlog pa
item.coloph: de ltar byad kha bzlog (zlog) pa'i yan lag 'di/ phyi rabs bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i phyir/ tshe dbang bdag gis thugs kyi bcud phyung ste/ mgul gyi rgyud drongs (drangs) ljags kyi pad mor bkram/ tshom gyi 'phrang thog las skal ldan pa la/ gnyer gtad lung gnang dgongs pa'i byin gyis rlobs (brlabs/)skabs zhig (shig) bon chos nyi zla 'char nub dus/ stang chenadamu tsha b+he ro tsa na dang / rjes 'bangs sa ra d+ha pa la sogs te/ grub pa'i gshen gyis brda' ris legs btab ste/ zhang zhung sgo mo shel le rdzong drug gi/ byang nub zangs mdog ri'i gnas tshab che/ zangs brag rin chen 'bar ba'i ri bo la/ gter sbas phyis su rten 'brel lnga shar tshe/ nges med sprul sku gshed bzhi lo pa yi/ zab mo gter du rnyed pa'i smon lam thob/ gter srung ma btsan rnams kyis bya ra gzob (gzobs //) phyis su bdag 'dra gshen spral thugs rje nyi ma/ sbas dngos kyi grogs dang bcas/ mched grogs grwa 'ga' chab (chabs) gcig phug l-ib 'o ma stag rtser ma rgyud tshogs 'brel yul sa'i mtha' bskor ba la phebs pa'i skabs der/ brag tsi ta ba'i ngos nas sman dri bzang thul ba dang bcas te/ zab mo khrom gter du spyan drangs te/ lo mang bka' rgya sdom (bsdoms) nas gsang ba mdzad/ slar rta sbral lor/ brten (rten) 'brel sgo brgya 'byed pa'i rigs bzang / hor sras bsod nams rgyal mtshan rin po che dang*/ grwa rgyal gtan (bstan) g.yung drung 'od zer ye tshul blon bra bo sku mched sogs/ mched grog (grogs) dam pa rnams nas bskyal ngor/ g.yu brag seng ge gnam rdzong gi yar zhor/ bkra shis lha steng gi gnas su rdzogs chen gsang ba'i bon 'chad pa'i thun mtshams su/ shog ser bod yig tu phab ste spel ba'o//
